I then called on Monday, as instructed, only to be told that there were no appointments available. This is completely unacceptable, especially considering I had already been informed that I have an infection and needed to speak to a doctor. Being told to call on a specific day, then finding out there is no availability, shows a serious lack of organisation and concern for patient care.

I have now been told I have to wait another full week to be seen, despite already being made aware of a medical issue through my blood test results. Delaying treatment for an infection after informing a patient about it is not only frustrating, but potentially harmful.

This experience has caused unnecessary stress and worry, and I find the level of service provided by the surgery to be extremely poor. I would like an explanation as to why I was told to book a telephone appointment on Monday if no appointments were actually available, and why a patient with confirmed results showing an infection is expected to wait even longer for any medical advice or
